current: Long single-column page: ScoutingCentre hero (spotlight discovery, stats, need-based recommendations, scout workload) stacked above a market-stage band with overlapping counters, then seven panels (Dina scouter, Ny bevakning, Nytt bredare uppdrag, Aktiva uppdrag, Färdiga rapporter, Breda uppdrag, Upptäckta spelare). "Öppna rapport" lands on the player profile; the title promises Motståndaranalys that is not here.
reason: The scouting loop is about turning fog into a decision. Shortlist & Reports gives reports a real home (fixing the "Öppna rapport → profile" dead end), keeps one pipeline strip instead of three lists, and hands shortlisted players straight to the transfer flow. A's search table stays available as the "Sök" mode inside it.
dependencies: Knowledge range bar (star range that tightens with Kännedom)
Rename page to "Scouting" (move Motståndaranalys to ANL-03)

alternatives.name: Search Workbench
alternatives.concept: A power-user instrument: one filter bar and one ranked table of every known player, with scouts as assignable resources in a right rail. Fog of war is a column, not a paragraph: ability/potential shown as star-range bars that narrow as Kännedom rises.
alternatives.layout: Top: query bar with saved filters (position MV/VS/VN/MN/HN/HS/M, ålder, liga, nation, kännedom-nivå). Centre: table (Spelare, Pos, Ålder, Klubb, Kännedom meter, Förmåga range, Potential range, Värde range, Status). Right rail: scouts with workload pips and a drop zone; below it the active-assignment queue with ETA.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Ranked results for the current need filter. 2) Scout capacity (who is free). 3) Running assignments and fresh reports badge.
alternatives.interactions: Multi-select rows → "Scouta" with chosen scout; drag a row onto a scout card to assign; Kortlista toggle per row (bulk too); saved filter chips ("Behov: VN under 24"); broad assignment is a "Spara som bevakning" action on any filter (club/competition/nation/position+max age).
alternatives.navigation: Rows open the Peek drawer (report summary + "Hela rapporten"); "Lägg bud" deep-links REC-04. Lives under Rekrytering hub tab "Scouting"; ⌘K "scouta <namn>".
alternatives.desktop: Dense hairline table, sticky header, keyboard row navigation, column chooser, density toggle.
alternatives.mobile: Ranked cards (name, pos, star-range bar, kännedom ring); filter chips in a bottom sheet; scouts become a horizontal capacity strip; long-press = Peek.
pros: Fastest path from need to assignment
Makes fog of war visible and sortable
Replaces the Ny bevakning search + Upptäckta table with one table
cons: Least narrative; reports still feel like rows
Risk of becoming a fourth market table unless it is the shared table component
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

alternatives.name: Scouting Board
alternatives.concept: The scouting office wall: a kanban of player cards moving Upptäckt → Bevakas → Rapport klar → Kortlista, with scout faces pinned to the cards they work on. Each card shows a star-range that visibly tightens between columns.
alternatives.layout: Header strip with scout portraits and workload rings. Four columns of cards. A "Nytt uppdrag" tray on the right for broad assignments (club/competition/nation/position).
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Cards in "Rapport klar" (new news). 2) Scout availability. 3) Discovery column volume.
alternatives.interactions: Drag card between columns (Bevakas = assign scout; Kortlista = shortlist); drop a card on a scout face to assign; click card → flip to report summary; broad assignments appear as "sweep" tiles that spawn cards over time.
alternatives.navigation: "Lägg bud" on any Kortlista card goes to REC-04; card overflow menu → Jämför (SQD-04), profil (SQD-02).
alternatives.desktop: Full-width board with horizontal scroll per column, card density switch (bust/compact).
alternatives.mobile: One column at a time with segmented tabs and counts; swipe card right to promote; scouts in a top carousel.
pros: Pipeline legible at a glance (inventory opportunity)
Merges three list panels into one board
cons: Poor for scanning 200 discoveries; needs a list fallback
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

alternatives.name: Shortlist & Reports
alternatives.concept: Editorial scouting desk: finished scout reports are articles (kicker, headline verdict, confidence, strengths/weaknesses in words, value range) and the Kortlista is a ranked column beside them. A thin pipeline strip on top replaces the three list panels and the duplicate counters.
alternatives.layout: Top: pipeline strip (Upptäckta n · Under scouting n · Rapporter n · Kortlista n) and scout faces with free/busy. Left 8 cols: "Nya rapporter" feed of report cards (scout byline, confidence %, knowledge-gain bar from → to). Right 4 cols: Kortlista ranked by priority with need tag; below it "Ge ett uppdrag" compact form.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Newest report verdicts. 2) Kortlista and what is ready to bid on. 3) Scout capacity and new assignment.
alternatives.interactions: Open report → standalone report view (Peek → full page) with "Lägg på kortlistan", "Scouta igen", "Lägg bud"; priority reorder by drag in Kortlista; "Ge ett uppdrag" accepts a player, a club, a competition, a nation or position+age in one field (typeahead) and shows expected duration where known.
alternatives.navigation: Kortlista is the same list REC-03 and SQD-02 use (renamed from "Bevakade"). Report links from inbox (WLD-01) open the same report view. Week Spine pins show when assignments finish.
alternatives.desktop: Two-column journal grid; reports as framed cards with scout portrait byline.
alternatives.mobile: Today-style feed of report cards; Kortlista as a second tab; sticky "Nytt uppdrag" button opening a bottom sheet.
pros: Fixes the report dead end with a real report view
Feeds directly into transfer flow via Kortlista
cons: Needs good generated verdict copy from ScoutReportView recommendation text
Expected duration needs new data: assignment duration estimate unless derivable from scout ability
patterns: Attribute bars + numbers, fogged by scouting

current: ScoutingCentre hero: spotlight on the newest discovery, stats, need-based recommendations with star ranges, scout workload rail, latest discoveries; duplicates the counters below it.

alternatives.name: Compact header strip

alternatives.navigation: Tiles are filters, not navigation (inform vs navigate).

alternatives.name: Need-driven recommendations rail

alternatives.interactions: Kortlista / Scouta per candidate; "Visa fler" opens filtered search.

alternatives.name: Scout capacity cards

alternatives.interactions: Card is a drop target for assignments; click → staff profile.
alternatives.navigation: "Rekrytera scout" as trailing ghost card → staff recruitment.

alternatives.name: Merged into staff peek

cons: Capacity not visible at decision time

current: Targeted assignment: search, 6-column table (Spelare, Pos, Ålder, Klubb, Kännedom, Välj), scout select, start; ?target= preselects; errors as plain text.
reason: Assignment should be an action on a player, not a separate search; a one-step sheet reached from any player mention removes a whole table.

alternatives.name: Inline in Search Workbench

alternatives.interactions: Bulk assign; validation inline on the action bar.

alternatives.name: "Scouta" action sheet

alternatives.interactions: One click start; errors inline next to the field.
alternatives.navigation: Return to where you were; assignment appears in pipeline and Week Spine.

alternatives.navigation: Creates a sweep in the pipeline.

alternatives.mobile: List of competitions with coverage bars.

alternatives.name: Single pipeline list

alternatives.navigation: Reports open report view, not profile.

alternatives.name: Pipeline table with stage tabs

alternatives.mobile: Stage dropdown + ranked cards; drawer as full-screen sheet.

Needs stage in URL and pipeline status helper shared with REC-04

URL state for mode and tab

Köp: tabs Möjligheter / Hela marknaden / Kortlista, filter row, table (Spelare, Pos, Ålder, Klubb, Kontrakt till, Förmåga range, Värde range, Intresse, Status). Right: Deal Panel (selected player: ranges, interest assessment, contract, "Förhandla", "Föreslå lån", "Kortlista", "Jämför").
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Budget headroom. 2) Market rows ranked by need fit. 3) Selected player's deal readiness.

current: Förhandlingsrum: photo hero with parties, ProgressSteps (Klubben → Spelaren/Speltiden → Signering/Lånet), deadline clock, two party asides around a decision section, a timeline of rounds, acquisition summary with training compensation, DealCompletion moment. No visible acceptance range beyond counters; answers require leaving the room to advance time.
reason: Negotiation is a numbers decision under uncertainty. The Term Sheet puts our offer, their counter and our knowledge-gated value range on the same axis, keeps the round history visible, and adds an inline "advance to answer" so the user never leaves the room. C's editorial ledger is a good secondary lens for history.
dependencies: Shared negotiation pattern (renewals SQD-05, staff STF-02b)

alternatives.name: Term Sheet
alternatives.concept: A two-column term sheet: left "Vårt bud", right "Deras krav" (club then player), aligned row by row (Övergångssumma, Lön/månad, År, Signeringsbonus, Utlovad roll). Each money row has a slider over a band showing the knowledge-gated market value range and the last counter as a marker.
alternatives.layout: Header: parties (crest ↔ crest, player chip) + stepper + deadline. Main: term-sheet grid with gap column ("skiljer 120 000 kr"). Right: budget waterfall impact (fee + wage over contract vs remaining budget/lönerum) and training compensation. Bottom: round history (compact).
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Gap between us and them per term. 2) Budget consequence. 3) History and deadline.
alternatives.interactions: Drag slider or type; "Möt motbudet" snaps to their marker; "Lägg budet" / "Lägg fram villkoren"; "Dra dig ur" behind confirm; waiting state shows "Svar väntas tor 14/3" with inline "Spela fram till svaret".
alternatives.navigation: Back to REC-03/REC-02; completion → DealCompletion → squad/tactics. Same component reused for renewals (SQD-05) and staff hiring (STF-02b).
alternatives.desktop: Grid 8/12 + impact panel 4/12; numbers tabular mono.
alternatives.mobile: One term per card with slider; sticky footer with gap total and primary CTA; impact in a collapsible bar.
pros: Removes need to leave the room
cons: Acceptance zone beyond counters needs new data: acceptance probability — do not show
Slider precision on mobile needs steppers

Sticky footer: STARTA MATCH / Snabbresultat, or "Spela fram till matchdagen".

Completing the steps flips to Floodlight for kick-off.

alternatives.navigation: Step 2 embeds ANL-03 summary; step 3 embeds TRN-02 summary; kick-off → MDY-02.

alternatives.concept: Tactics as a few named shouts ("Höj tempot", "Gå 5-1", "Extraspelare") mapped to existing choices, with effect/trade-off text like TimeoutOverlay directives.
cons: Must map exactly to existing settings

current: Non-modal TimeoutOverlay: contextual directives by score margin/period (e.g. "Hög press & snabb omställning", "Täta bakåt & kontrollerat tempo", "Extraspela 7 mot 6") with effect/trade-off/duration, base tactics, on-court substitution picker, resume banner; duplicates LiveCoachPanel; inline styles.
reason: The huddle should be a focused phase that uses the Bench Dock rather than a second copy of it.

alternatives.name: Timeout huddle phase
alternatives.concept: Centre view becomes a huddle: 2–3 directive cards (effect, trade-off, duration) on a whiteboard-style court; dock stays on the right for subs; "Återuppta" primary.
alternatives.mobile: Full-screen card stack with resume sticky.

alternatives.name: Whiteboard overlay
alternatives.concept: Full-screen huddle with coach whiteboard drawing the directive's shape.

alternatives.name: Opponent timeout notice
alternatives.concept: Opponent timeouts as a slim banner with "Ändra något?" opening the dock.

current: Half-time: view forced to Översikt, heading "Nästa halvlek börjar med ditt beslut.", button "Starta andra halvlek"; no first-half summary or energy view.
reason: A dedicated briefing with first-half numbers vs plan, energy and the dock is the main inventory opportunity.

alternatives.name: Half-time briefing
alternatives.concept: Three columns: Första halvlek i siffror (score, Mål/skott %, räddning %, bollförluster, 2 min, 7m vs opponent), Energi (on-court & bench bars, lowest first), Assistentens förslag (from existing analysis interpretations, if any). Dock on right; "Starta andra halvlek".
alternatives.mobile: Swipe cards: Siffror · Energi · Förslag; sticky start.
cons: Assistant suggestions need new data unless derived from interpretations

alternatives.name: Dressing-room talk
alternatives.concept: Locker-room scene with captain and assistant; numbers as a chalkboard.
cons: Team talk would invent gameplay – presentation only

alternatives.name: Half-time editorial
alternatives.concept: "Halvtid: 14–12" kicker + a short paragraph of the first half, momentum line, then dock.

current: Full-time: same surface in review mode with a summary headline, coach aside hidden, "Slutför match och öppna rapport"; the report then re-renders much of the same content.
reason: Full time should be a short verdict and a single handoff to the report story – no second copy of the match center.

alternatives.name: Final-whistle card
alternatives.concept: Floodlight card: final score, halftime score, one-line story, top performer, table effect ("Upp till 5:e"), single CTA "Läs matchrapporten".

alternatives.name: Merge with report
alternatives.concept: Finalise automatically and transform the page in place into the ANL-01 layout.

alternatives.name: Celebration/blues moment
alternatives.concept: Short win/loss moment (2 s) then the card from A.

current: Manager suspended: banner and "{name} leder laget" box replaces the coach panel; manager watches.
reason: Make the state clear and calm.

alternatives.name: Assistant dock
alternatives.concept: Dock shows assistant face, "leder laget" and read-only current tactics.

alternatives.name: Stand view
alternatives.concept: Visual change: "Från läktaren" framing.

current: Experimental 2D court in a <details> with English label; numbered circles and ball from frame buffer; hidden by default.
reason: Promote it to a first-class "Plan" view tab, Swedish label, with trails.

alternatives.name: "Plan" view tab
alternatives.concept: Court as view tab with player circles in club colours, trails (last n seconds), manpower overlay.

alternatives.name: Picture-in-picture court
alternatives.concept: Small court PiP above the dock.

current: ?finish=1 auto-sims to full time then redirects; loading, error and archive replay fallbacks as plain paragraphs and buttons.
reason: A simulation progress screen makes quick finish feel intended.

alternatives.name: Simulation progress
alternatives.concept: Score bug ticking with a 0–60 progress bar and goal ticks, then auto-open report.

alternatives.name: Styled fallback states
alternatives.concept: Error, loading, no session with consistent empty-state component and way out.

current: Server redirect /career/match-center → /career/matches → client redirect /career/schedule (double redirect).
reason: Redirect directly; dev-only concern.

alternatives.name: Direct redirect
alternatives.concept: Redirect straight to /career/schedule.

alternatives.name: Remove
alternatives.concept: Remove after link audit.

current: Orphaned /career/match-2d replay page: bare select of archived matches then ArchiveReplay; source has broken encoding (every Swedish character shows as "?").
reason: Fold replays into the report as a "Repris" tab (and history), fix encoding; a standalone page is not needed.

alternatives.name: Replay library
alternatives.concept: Styled list of archived matches by season with score, opponent and a play button.
alternatives.navigation: Add to Tävling or Karriär hub.

alternatives.name: Highlight cinema
alternatives.concept: Replay as broadcast highlight reel of key moments.

alternatives.name: "Repris" tab in report
alternatives.concept: Remove the page; ANL-01 gets a Repris tab with the court replay; history links to reports.

current: Matchrapport in two divergent variants. Archive variant: full ArchivedMatchCenter (same 4 views as live), HeadToHeadStatsComparison (stats shown twice), MatchAftermathPanel, PostMatchPressBanner, an action bar with two primaries (press + continue) and a "Speltid och belastning" table. "Se matchrepris" opens /match-day which renders the same replay again. Legacy variant looks different.
reason: An editorial report that reads top-down as one post-match story — score → turning points → player ratings → workload consequences → what to change — removes the duplicated match-center rendering and the circular "Se matchrepris". It absorbs ANL-05 for any match, keeps the stats sheet as a tab for depth, and works for both archive and legacy data.

alternatives.name: Stats Sheet
alternatives.concept: A box score: final and half-time score, team comparison table, player rating table for both teams (Min, Mål/Skott, Räddningar/Mötta, 2 min, Betyg), shot map, then workload. One page, no narrative.
alternatives.layout: Header score band → 2-col (team comparison 6 | score flow 6) → player box score full width (tabs per team) → shot map + keeper → Speltid och belastning.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Score. 2) Box score. 3) Shot map and workload.
alternatives.interactions: Sort box score; filter shot map; row → player Peek; "Vila i morgon" per player in workload table.
alternatives.navigation: Single action bar: Fortsätt (primary), Möt pressen (secondary when open), Tabell. Replay as a tab, not a link to /match-day.
alternatives.mobile: Score band, then accordions per section; box score as ranked cards.
pros: Fast to read for power users

alternatives.name: Highlight Show
alternatives.concept: A post-match TV segment: hero with the result in giant numerals and club colours, a reel of key moments as replay cards (court snapshots), "Matchens lirare" spotlight, media headlines ticker, then the press-room door.
alternatives.layout: Hero → horizontal highlight reel → player of the match + ratings → headlines → press CTA.
alternatives.interactions: Play reel (snapshots step through, optional 2D court replay); tap player → spotlight; "Möt pressen".
alternatives.navigation: Comes after MDY-02 broadcast; Fortsätt returns to Today.
alternatives.mobile: Vertical swipe stories (each highlight a card).

alternatives.name: Editorial Match Report
alternatives.concept: The club journal's match page: headline and kicker generated from the result ("Sen vändning i Kristianstad"), a momentum chart as the hero image, three turning points with court snapshots, a player ratings column, a "Vad det kostade" workload box with actions, and "Vad vi tar med oss" linking to training and tactics. Depth lives in tabs: Rapport · Statistik · Repris.
alternatives.layout: Header: score + HT, competition, headline. Rapport tab: momentum hero (goal difference per minute, scoring runs marked) 8 | ratings column 4 → Avgörande ögonblick (3 snapshot cards) → Belastning box with "Vila"/"Lätt pass" per player → Nästa steg (training, tactics, table, press). Statistik tab = Stats Sheet (A). Repris tab = court replay (replaces MDY-04 and "Se matchrepris").
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Score + headline. 2) How it happened (momentum + turning points). 3) Consequences and next steps.
alternatives.interactions: Click a momentum point → that snapshot; ratings → Peek; workload actions set next-day training load (existing FULL/REDUCED/RECOVERY_ONLY/REST); one primary "Fortsätt", press as a clearly secondary box.
alternatives.navigation: Entered from MDY-02j final-whistle card; ANL-05 merges in as this page for any match (picker in header); CMP-01c results link here.
alternatives.desktop: Paper mode journal, 8/4 grid, serif headline.
alternatives.mobile: Story order preserved: score, headline, momentum, turning points as swipe cards, ratings list, workload actions, sticky Fortsätt.
pros: One story, no duplicated match center
cons: Headline/turning-point copy must be generated from events (risk of repetition)
Legacy variant lacks snapshots – section degrades to text

current: Full ArchivedMatchCenter (Översikt / Nyckelögonblick / Spelare / Statistik) read-only with Experimental 2D; heavy for a report.
reason: Keep the views but as depth tabs behind the report summary, sharing components with the live match.

alternatives.name: Depth tabs behind summary
alternatives.concept: Statistik and Repris tabs reuse MDY-02f and MDY-02l components; Översikt is replaced by the report story.

alternatives.name: Collapsed "Hela matchen" section
alternatives.concept: One collapsed section at the bottom containing the archived center.

alternatives.name: Moment explorer
alternatives.concept: Replace the four views by a timeline scrubber + snapshot (MDY-02d A).

current: MatchAftermathPanel: media headlines, voices after the final whistle, small "Målskillnaden minut för minut" SVG.
reason: Promote the goal-difference chart to the report hero; headlines and voices become a side column.

alternatives.name: Momentum hero
alternatives.concept: Large goal-difference-per-minute chart with scoring runs shaded and half-time line; goals as ticks.

alternatives.name: Press clippings
alternatives.concept: Headlines as newspaper clippings with tone per outlet.

current: Open <details> table: minutes, energy after match, match workload (estimated for GKs), last-7-days load; no link to adjust training.
reason: Close the loop: rest/reduce actions inline.

alternatives.name: Workload with actions
alternatives.concept: Rows sorted by load, energy bar, 7-day load vs typical, and a load selector (Full / Reducerad / Endast återhämtning / Vila) for next day.
alternatives.interactions: Set load inline; bulk "Vila alla >50 min".

alternatives.name: Heat strip
alternatives.concept: Readiness heat-strip per player (energy × fitness × 7-day load).

current: Legacy fallback when archive is missing: MatchHero, best players, table position, stats comparison, rating tables; different look.
reason: Same report layout with sections degrading gracefully.

alternatives.name: Unified layout, degraded sections
alternatives.concept: Same header and sections; missing sections show "Ingen detaljdata för den här matchen".

alternatives.name: Compact result card
alternatives.concept: Legacy matches show only a result card with ratings.

current: "Den här matchen saknar en rapport." and archive load error with "Försök igen"; no navigation out.
reason: Always offer back links.

alternatives.name: Empty state with routes
alternatives.concept: Message + Försök igen + Schema + Tabell links.

alternatives.name: Fallback to fixture page
alternatives.concept: Redirect to CMP-02 with a notice.

current: Banner entry to post-match press conference (media owned by part A).
reason: Secondary placement so "Fortsätt" stays the only primary.

alternatives.name: Secondary press box
alternatives.concept: Side box "Pressen väntar" with journalist face and optional status.

alternatives.name: Inbox task
alternatives.concept: Press conference appears as an inbox task instead.

current: Analysis hub: SectionScene + route tabs; overview with next-opponent MatchHero, last match panel, own last-five form and metrics, observed patterns as text; thin and duplicates preview/report entry points.
reason: A trend dashboard with "what changed" cards is the real value; next-match and last-match entries become links rather than duplicate heroes.
dependencies: IA decision: analysis inside Tävling or Laget hub

alternatives.name: Trend dashboard
alternatives.concept: Rolling trend lines over the season for goals for/against per match, Mål/skott %, räddning %, bollförluster, 2 min and 7m-effektivitet, with "Vad har ändrats" cards (biggest change last five vs season) from existing patterns/interpretations.
alternatives.layout: KPI tiles (value, delta, spark) → trend chart with metric picker → what-changed cards → links (Nästa motståndare, Senaste matchen).
alternatives.interactions: Pick metric; window toggle; card → relevant plan/training.
alternatives.navigation: Tabs: Översikt · Motståndaren · Vårt lag · Matcher (any match via ANL-01).
cons: Evidence missing states must be shown honestly

alternatives.name: Analyst's room
alternatives.concept: Assistant/analyst presents 3 findings as slides with charts.

alternatives.name: Weekly analysis column
alternatives.concept: Editorial column "Formen just nu" with inline charts, linked to the week.

current: Four route tabs (Översikt / Motståndaren / Vårt lag / Senaste matchen) with aria-current.
reason: Replace "Senaste matchen" by "Matcher" (any match → report story) since ANL-05 merges into ANL-01.

alternatives.name: Three tabs + match picker
alternatives.concept: Översikt · Motståndaren · Vårt lag · Matcher (picker → ANL-01).

alternatives.name: Hub secondary row
alternatives.concept: Tabs become the hub secondary row under Tävling/Laget.

current: Next opponent: MatchHero, scouting report ordering, recent matches, attack and defence metrics over last five, rail with facts, patterns and interpretation; no side-by-side comparison with own numbers.
reason: A mirror of us vs them per metric is the missing comparison and the cleanest way to show matchups.

alternatives.name: Mirror comparison
alternatives.concept: Per metric bar pairs: them (left) vs us (right) for Mål/match, Skott/match, Skotteffektivitet, Bollförluster/match, 7m-effektivitet, Insläppta/match, Räddningsprocent, Utvisningar/match; threat cards with confidence; recommendation links to specific plan settings.
alternatives.layout: Opponent header → mirror chart 8 + threat cards 4 → recent matches table.
alternatives.hierarchy: Where they are stronger → threats → evidence.
alternatives.interactions: Window toggle; threat card → plan setting; order report.
cons: Mapping recommendation → plan setting limited to existing recommendations

alternatives.name: Opponent dossier
alternatives.concept: Opponent presented like a rival profile: crest hero, key players busts, style tags.
cons: Style tags need derivation from patterns

alternatives.name: Scout report article
alternatives.concept: Scout's report as an article with confidence per section and charts inline.

current: Own team over last five or season: form, goal difference, attack & defence metrics, outfield and goalkeeper season tables (ignoring the window toggle), patterns.
reason: Rolling trends plus tables that respect the window fix the main confusion.

alternatives.name: Trends + window-aware tables
alternatives.concept: Rolling lines per metric, player contribution bars; tables respect window or label "Hela säsongen" explicitly.
cons: Window player stats need per-match aggregation (data exists in archives; verify)

alternatives.name: Squad contribution court
alternatives.concept: Contribution per position drawn on the court.

alternatives.name: Merge into ANL-02
alternatives.concept: Fold into the trend dashboard as "Vårt lag" section.

current: Latest own match deep dive: scoreboard, team match facts, player contributions, filterable event timeline, halves split, scoring runs, patterns; largely duplicates the report; no match picker.
reason: Merge into the report (ANL-01 C) so any match gets the same story + depth; its unique parts (halves split, scoring runs) become report sections.

alternatives.name: Keep as stats deep dive with picker
alternatives.concept: Add a match picker and remove facts already on the report.

alternatives.name: Replay-led analysis
alternatives.concept: Event timeline drives a court replay.

alternatives.name: Merge into report
alternatives.concept: Route redirects to the latest ANL-01 report; halves split and scoring runs become report sections; event filter (Mål, Räddningar, Bollförluster, 2 min, 7m) becomes the report timeline.
